entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Provisional Government of India was a provisional government-in-exile established in Kabul, Afghanistan on 1 December 1915 by the Indian Independence Committee during World War I with support from the Central Powers. Its purpose was to enrol support from the Afghan Emir as well as Tsarist Russia, China, and Japan for the Indian Movement.
